    One-parameter matrix families of thin representations #

    A family of matrix representations M t of a thin category, indexed by an infinite type, gives representation-infiniteness as soon as its natural endomorphisms are scalars and natural maps between different members vanish at one vertex of positive dimension (RayCat.MatFam.not_isRepresentationFinite). The hypotheses are matrix identities, checked shape by shape.

    Type (max u u_1)

    A family of matrix representations of ThinCat T.

    • d : V → ℕ
    • M : α → (x y : V) → Matrix (Fin (self.d y)) (Fin (self.d x)) k
    • M_id (t : α) (x : V) : self.M t x x = 1
    • M_comp (t : α) (x y z : V) : T.le x y → T.le y z → self.M t y z * self.M t x y = if T.nz x y z then self.M t x z else 0
